focus: This week: we can now pinpoint exactly which interaction is causing performance slowness on our pages — a new telemetry layer records the specific button or element responsible for input delays over 150ms. We also built a composite Core Web Vitals health score (all three metrics passing simultaneously per page), automated changelog drafts so session work gets captured in human-readable form, and wired push notification prompts to appear right after the game quiz with game-specific personalized copy.
nextStep: Improving how quickly the games page responds to clicks, and publishing the latest studio update once it is ready for review.
